parts.name: beam body

physics.Basic_description: Long, flat silver metallic bar forming the main spine of the caliper with a matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid structural backbone and reference edge for measurements.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the flat sides of the beam away from the scale markings to avoid obscuring readings.
physics.reason: Caliper beams are typically solid machined or stamped steel bars for rigidity.

parts.description: Long, flat silver metallic bar forming the main spine of the caliper with a matte finish.
parts.function: Provides the rigid structural backbone and reference edge for measurements.

parts.name: beam scale

physics.Basic_description: Green-tinted strip along the beam representing the graduated measurement scale.
physics.Functional_description: Displays the linear measurement increments for reading values.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; this is a reading surface that should remain visible and clean.
physics.reason: The scale is etched or printed directly onto the solid beam surface.

parts.description: Green-tinted strip along the beam representing the graduated measurement scale.
parts.function: Displays the linear measurement increments for reading values.

parts.name: beam web

physics.Basic_description: Central recessed or structural section of the metal beam.
physics.Functional_description: Adds stiffness to the beam while reducing weight slightly.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp point; gripper would likely contact the wider beam edges.
physics.reason: Part of the monolithic solid steel beam structure.

parts.description: Central recessed or structural section of the metal beam.
parts.function: Adds stiffness to the beam while reducing weight slightly.

parts.name: guide rail mark

physics.Basic_description: Small marking or feature on the guide rail area of the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Indicates alignment or limits for the sliding mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small to grasp; incidental contact only.
physics.reason: Surface feature on the solid beam.

parts.description: Small marking or feature on the guide rail area of the beam.
parts.function: Indicates alignment or limits for the sliding mechanism.

parts.name: main scale ticks

physics.Basic_description: Fine engraved lines on the beam surface indicating measurement units.
physics.Functional_description: Allows precise reading of the measurement value.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; these are delicate markings on the surface.
physics.reason: Engravings on the solid metal beam.

parts.description: Fine engraved lines on the beam surface indicating measurement units.
parts.function: Allows precise reading of the measurement value.

parts.name: fixed jaw

physics.Basic_description: Stationary L-shaped metal block at the left end of the beam with a purple hue in mask.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the fixed reference surface against which objects are measured.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the outer faces to hold the caliper steady during use.
physics.reason: Jaws are solid machined metal blocks to withstand clamping forces.

parts.description: Stationary L-shaped metal block at the left end of the beam with a purple hue in mask.
parts.function: Provides the fixed reference surface against which objects are measured.

parts.name: slider body

physics.Basic_description: Movable cyan-colored assembly that slides along the beam, housing the dial mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Moves the measuring jaws and translates linear motion to the dial readout.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp point; grip the thumb roller or side wings to slide the jaw.
physics.reason: The slider body is a cast or stamped shell enclosing the gear mechanism and dial, not a solid block.

parts.description: Movable cyan-colored assembly that slides along the beam, housing the dial mechanism.
parts.function: Moves the measuring jaws and translates linear motion to the dial readout.

parts.name: thumb roller

physics.Basic_description: Small magenta-colored knurled wheel on the slider for fine adjustment.
physics.Functional_description: Allows the user to precisely move the slider with their thumb.
physics.Grasped_description: Designed to be rolled by the thumb; gripper can pinch it to actuate.
physics.reason: Small functional component typically machined solid for durability.

parts.description: Small magenta-colored knurled wheel on the slider for fine adjustment.
parts.function: Allows the user to precisely move the slider with their thumb.

parts.name: depth rod

physics.Basic_description: Thin pink-colored rod extending from the right end of the beam.
physics.Functional_description: Measures the depth of holes or steps by extending from the beam end.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and fragile to grasp directly; avoid bending.
physics.reason: Depth rods are thin solid metal strips or wires.

parts.description: Thin pink-colored rod extending from the right end of the beam.
parts.function: Measures the depth of holes or steps by extending from the beam end.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
